title: German Pineapple Strudel
description: A sweet and tangy twist on the traditional German pastry, featuring caramelized pineapple and a hint of exotic spices.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together pineapple, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and exotic spices.
Spread the pineapple mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges with melted butter.
Roll the pastry into a tight log, starting from one of the long edges.
Place the log on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, seam-side down.
Brush the top of the pastry with the beaten egg.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
